status: source-verified summaries and manual anchors for exploratory joint calibration; not a preregistration

observation.limitations: Digitized points on each curve are correlated and are not additional animals.

observation.timing_qualification: The furosemide EP and resistance entries carry the greatest-EP-decrease footnote; the prose says resistance was measured at that time. The six-minute footnote applies to saline, not furosemide. The table-cohort nadir time is not numerically specified; the separate Figure 3 cohort has an approximately two-minute EP nadir.
observation.limitations: Ratio of rounded means is not a reported individual-level ratio; uncertainty and baseline/post covariance of the ratio are unavailable. Effective partition resistance is not a directly measured strial conductance.

observation.kind: Table III group mean reductions plus standard errors
observation.limitations: Table III was visually checked on PDF page 4; 100 mg/kg n is 7. Group EP and K minimum times are not reported as synchronized; representative figure traces are individual animals, not group means. A mean of individual minima is not necessarily the minimum of a group trajectory.

not_used_in_numerical_objective.reason: Not included in historical joint fits or resistance-only nadir refits. It is included in a separate outcome-informed endpoint-weight sensitivity; table-cohort time and paired covariance are not provided.
Local intercellular-space fractions are not a measured model volume or water flux; a spatial and fixation observation model is needed.
Reference 14-state baseline is fixed at 150 mM rather than a study-specific baseline; reductions avoid equating absolute baselines, but do not remove cross-species differences.
Not used in calibration; previous exploratory inspection prevents claiming blinded evaluation.
